title: Convert repeated mistakes into reusable checks
summary: When a failure or manual check repeats, capture the lesson and automate it when practical.
rule: If a mistake repeats, propose a reusable rule. If the rule can be checked deterministically, promote it into an automated validator or test after evidence review.
trigger: Repeated failure, repeated manual review, or recurring correction across projects

evidence.note: Foundational governance rule approved for the memory system.
